notes:
What's new in 0.1.107:
- Story Studio: the preview no longer shows a blank white picture. The fix applies only to the preview page (it keeps its one-time secret address); every other page keeps its protection.
- Users, View stats and the Dashboard's "watch time by member" now count the time really watched: each session is cut to the window shown, overlapping streams count once, and a player left open is capped, so a day can no longer show "61 hours today". Display only; no stored history was changed.
- Not fixed: changing video quality while a film plays can still restart the converter. A TV linked through a member sign-in can still get the owner's photo powers, and the wake-up information (a network address) can still be seen by a media-only session (both are follow-ups). Chromecast items are still being tested. In View stats, "all time" means the newest 300 kept sessions. Kitchen announcements have not been tested on a phone. The phone app and Beebo Auto are not in this release.
- Not yet checked: neither change has been tried by a person. Automated tests and reviews only; 0.1.106 has been updated to and retested by one tester working alone, no person has used 0.1.107.
- Release source commit edcb57edd.
